scripts.build: node scripts/make-docs.mjs && node scripts/make-samples.mjs && vite build
scripts.pc:build: vite build && npx --yes @electron/packager@18 . Canopy --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release/.win-tmp --overwrite --electron-version=33.4.11 --icon=build/icon.ico --ignore="^/(src|test|scripts|public|android|release|node_modules)" && node scripts/copy-win.cjs
scripts.android:setup: npm i -D @capacitor/cli@7 @capacitor/core@7 @capacitor/android@7 && npx cap add android
scripts.android:build: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && node scripts/copy-apk.cjs
scripts.web:build: node scripts/make-docs.mjs && node scripts/make-samples.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-web.cjs
